summary: Clough Global Opportunities Fund filed an 8-K announcing its Board of Trustees renewed an open-market share repurchase program, originally approved June 2023, allowing repurchase of up to 5% of outstanding common shares through June 30, 2027. The program aims to enhance shareholder value by buying shares when trading at a discount to net asset value. No specific price, premium, or advisor is named; purchases are at the adviser's discretion based on market conditions. This is a capital return initiative to reduce discount and support share price. Watch for periodic discount updates and repurchase pace.
